svg.aria-label: Pipeline diagram: Excel workbooks and Infor M3 flow through Bronze, Silver and Gold layers in DuckDB to Parquet files for Power BI
svg.text: Two pipelines into one DuckDB file (lakehouse.db): messy sources in, one governed star schema out.
Each step runs as a subprocess. A non-zero exit code or any WARNING: line stops the whole run, so a bad load never reaches Power BI.
